```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ape)
library(geomorph)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
ldk <- readRDS("aligned_landmarks.RDS")
species_dat <- read_csv("habitat_data.csv")
phy <- read.nexus("tree_file.nex")
```

## Habitat Data

```{r}
hab <- species_dat$habitat
names(hab) <- species_dat$sp
```

## Create Geomorph Data Frame

```{r}
phy_one <- phy[[1]]
gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(
  coords = ldk$coords,
  hab = hab,
  phy = phy_one
)
```
 
## Procrustes PGLS

```{r}
pgls <- procD.pgls(
  coords ~ hab,
  phy = phy_one,
  data = gdf,
  iter = 1000
)
```

## ANOVA

```{r}
anova(pgls)
```
